reasoning: All visual checks pass: diff10 images show only unstructured per-Gaussian speckle with no tile-grid seams, no uniform-fill blocks, no color clipping, no NaN/Inf signatures, and no geometry shift. The top diff10 shows slightly elevated noise at model perimeter edges, consistent with expected behavior from the contrib_floor=5/255 culling removing low-opacity boundary Gaussians — this is perceptual noise, not a structural artifact.
